title: Appraisal by AI: Model-driven victim prioritization in the VOLTA infostealer
description: VOLTA-AUTODOXER is a self-deleting Windows infostealer that uses AI to prioritize stolen victim data by monetization value. After harvesting credentials, sessions, wallets, and other sensitive data, it builds a detailed evidence bundle about the victim, enriched via stolen session access. This bundle is sent to an LLM via OpenRouter, which acts as an intelligence analyst to rank the victim's assets and assess their security posture. The malware uses a multi-model fallback approach to ensure the AI completes the assessment despite model refusals. VOLTA operates as a builder model, allowing customers to compile customized binaries with their own API keys. There is no attacker-owned infrastructure, and exfiltration occurs in multiple stages. The AI integration represents a novel approach in malware by automating victim profiling and prioritization.
